summary: Created an SSH CA on node1 (/etc/ssh/ca/ssh_ca, ed25519), signed node1's ed25519 host key into /etc/ssh/ssh_host_ed25519_key-cert.pub (principals: NODE_IP, node1, localhost; 10y validity), and configured sshd via /etc/ssh/sshd_config.d/00-hostcert.conf to present it. Verified an SSH client with only a @cert-authority known_hosts entry (no pinned host key) accepts the connection ("Host is known and matches the ED25519-CERT host certificate"). Completed the mandatory single-node restart protocol: captured boot_id baseline, restarted node1 via systemctl reboot, confirmed boot_id changed, and reverified sshd health and CA-trust behavior post-restart.
actions_performed: Inspected node1 OS/sshd baseline and existing host keys
Generated ed25519 SSH CA keypair at /etc/ssh/ca/ssh_ca
Signed node1's ed25519 host public key as a host certificate with ssh-keygen -s (10-year validity, principals NODE_IP/node1/localhost)
Added /etc/ssh/sshd_config.d/00-hostcert.conf with HostCertificate directive and reloaded sshd
Verified with a throwaway known_hosts containing only an @cert-authority line that a client trusts the host via the CA without a pinned host key
Captured pre-restart boot_id and service/file baseline
Rebooted node1 via systemctl reboot (backgrounded so ack returned before disconnect)
Polled node1 until reachable again and confirmed boot_id changed
Re-verified sshd active, cert files intact, and CA-based client trust after restart

evidence.requirement: Host key signed by the CA into a host certificate
evidence.summary: ssh-keygen -s signed ssh_host_ed25519_key.pub producing ssh_host_ed25519_key-cert.pub; ssh-keygen -L shows correct CA, principals, validity

evidence.requirement: sshd configured to present the certificate
evidence.summary: HostCertificate directive added, sshd -t passed, sshd reloaded and active; sshd -T confirms hostcertificate directive loaded

evidence.requirement: Client connects trusting only the CA, without pinning the host key
evidence.summary: ssh with known_hosts containing only @cert-authority line reports 'Host is known and matches the ED25519-CERT host certificate' and proceeds to auth
Captured boot_id 71f12f87... and confirmed sshd active plus cert/config files present before reboot

evidence.requirement: Node restart acknowledged and boot identity changed
evidence.summary: Backgrounded systemctl reboot acknowledged, node became unreachable during reboot, then returned with new boot_id 3caa371f... (changed from 71f12f87...)

evidence.requirement: Post-restart recovery of required services and CA-cert trust
evidence.summary: sshd active, host cert/CA/config files intact, and ssh CA-trust check again succeeds after reboot
